display.purpose: The single h1 on a page. Fluid from 2.25rem to 3rem, slightly tightened tracking.

headline.purpose: The h2 inside a section head, above the hairline rule and its 2.5rem gold bar.

title.purpose: An entry title in an accumulating list, the page lede, and the name in the rail.

body.purpose: Running prose, justified with automatic hyphenation, capped at 62ch.

label.purpose: Uppercase tracked micro-type: eyebrows, stat labels, filter legends, chips, footer. Also the 0.875rem metadata register for authors, venue and DOI, without the uppercase.

motion.name: state-color
motion.purpose: The only transition in the system. Applies to color, background-color, border-color and opacity — never to position, size or shadow.

motion.name: reduced-motion-clamp
motion.purpose: Under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce, every transition and animation duration collapses to this.

motion.name: view-transition
motion.purpose: Native cross-document transition between pages; no JS router, no custom keyframes.

components.name: Solid Button
components.description: The primary action. One per action row, and the only button that carries a fill.
components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-block; font-family: var(--font-family); font-size: var(--text-sm); font-weight: 500; text-decoration: none; padding: 0.5rem 0.95rem; border: 1px solid var(--accent-strong); border-radius: 2px; color: var(--accent-ink); transition: background-color 0.15s ease, color 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-solid { background-color: var(--accent); color: var(--accent-contrast); } .ds-btn-solid:hover, .ds-btn-solid:focus-visible { background-color: var(--accent-strong); color: var(--accent-contrast); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent-deep); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Every secondary action. Outline at rest; hover floods it with Gold Wash rather than changing the text colour.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display: inline-block; font-family: var(--font-family); font-size: var(--text-sm); font-weight: 500; text-decoration: none; padding: 0.5rem 0.95rem; border: 1px solid var(--accent-strong); border-radius: 2px; color: var(--accent-ink); background-color: transparent; transition: background-color 0.15s ease, color 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-outline:hover, .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { background-color: var(--accent-wash); color: var(--accent-ink); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent-deep); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Filter Chip
components.description: Toggles a facet on the publications and teaching lists. Pressed state is one of only two solid accent fills in the system.
components.css: .ds-chip { font-family: var(--font-family-data); font-size: var(--text-xs); cursor: pointer; background-color: var(--surface); color: var(--ink-soft); border: 1px solid var(--rule); border-radius: 2px; padding: 0.22rem 0.6rem; margin-right: 0.4rem; transition: background-color 0.15s ease, border-color 0.15s ease, color 0.15s ease; } .ds-chip:hover { border-color: var(--accent-strong); } .ds-chip[aria-pressed="true"] { background-color: var(--accent); border-color: var(--accent); color: var(--accent-contrast); } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent-deep); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Entry List Row
components.description: The signature component. A fixed 62px tabular ordering key in Olive Gold, then title, byline and metadata. The site owner's own name is lifted inside the byline so a reader can find his author position while scanning.

components.css: .ds-entry-list { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; border-top: 1px solid var(--rule-soft); } .ds-entry { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 62px minmax(0, 1fr); gap: 0 1.1rem; padding: 0.95rem 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule-soft); } .ds-entry-year { font-family: var(--font-family-data); font-size: var(--text-sm); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; font-weight: 500; color: var(--accent-ink); padding-top: 0.14rem; } .ds-entry-title { font-family: var(--font-family-display); font-size: var(--text-md); font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.35; margin: 0; } .ds-entry-title a { color: var(--ink); text-decoration: none; } .ds-entry-title a:hover { color: var(--accent-ink); text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 3px; } .ds-entry-authors { font-family: var(--font-family); font-size: var(--text-sm); color: var(--muted); margin: 0.25rem 0 0; text-align: left; } .ds-entry-authors .ds-me { color: var(--ink-soft); font-weight: 600; } .ds-entry-id { font-family: var(--font-family-data); font-size: var(--text-xs); color: var(--accent-ink); margin: 0.3rem 0 0; }

components.name: Section Head
components.description: Opens every section: headline, an optional trailing link, a hairline rule, and a 2.5rem Structural Gold bar sitting on top of that rule at the left edge.
components.css: .ds-section-head { position: relative; display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 1rem; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule); padding-bottom: 0.5rem; margin-bottom: 1.1rem; } .ds-section-head::after { content: ""; position: absolute; left: 0; bottom: -1px; width: 2.5rem; height: 2px; background-color: var(--accent-mark); } .ds-section-h { font-family: var(--font-family-display); font-weight: 600; font-size: var(--text-lg); line-height: 1.3; margin: 0; color: var(--ink); } .ds-more { margin-left: auto; font-family: var(--font-family-data); font-size: var(--text-xs); text-decoration: none; white-space: nowrap; color: var(--accent-ink); } .ds-more:hover { text-decoration: underline; color: var(--accent-deep); }

components.name: Navigation
components.description: The card catalogue in the rail. A 6px hollow bullet per row; the current page fills its bullet with Burnished Gold and is the only 'you are here' signal.
components.css: .ds-nav { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; } .ds-nav a { display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 0.6rem; padding: 0.38rem 0; font-family: var(--font-family); font-size: var(--text-sm); color: var(--ink-soft); text-decoration: none; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule-soft); transition: color 0.15s ease; } .ds-nav a::before { content: ""; width: 6px; height: 6px; flex: none; border-radius: 50%; border: 1px solid var(--rule); transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-nav a:hover { color: var(--accent-ink); } .ds-nav a[aria-current="page"] { color: var(--ink); font-weight: 600; } .ds-nav a[aria-current="page"]::before { background-color: var(--accent-strong); border-color: var(--accent-strong); } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent-deep); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Card

components.css: .ds-cards { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; } .ds-card { border: 1px solid var(--rule); border-radius: 2px; padding: 1rem 1.15rem; background-color: var(--surface); } .ds-tl-period { display: block; font-family: var(--font-family-data); font-size: var(--text-xs); color: var(--muted); text-align: left; } .ds-card-h { font-family: var(--font-family); font-size: var(--text-base); font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.4; margin: 0.2rem 0 0; color: var(--ink); } .ds-card-h a { color: var(--ink); text-decoration: none; } .ds-card-h a::after { content: " \2192"; color: var(--accent-strong); } .ds-card-h a:hover { text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 3px; } .ds-card p { font-family: var(--font-family); font-size: var(--text-sm); color: var(--muted); margin: 0.35rem 0 0; text-align: justify; hyphens: auto; }

components.css: .ds-stats { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); border-top: 1px solid var(--rule); margin: 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; } .ds-stat { border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule); border-right: 1px solid var(--rule-soft); padding: 0.85rem 1rem 0.9rem; } .ds-stat:last-child { border-right: none; } .ds-n { display: block; font-family: var(--font-family-display); font-size: var(--text-xl); font-weight: 600; line-height: 1; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; color: var(--ink); } .ds-l { display: block; margin-top: 0.3rem; font-family: var(--font-family-data); font-size: var(--text-xs); letter-spacing: 0.07em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--muted); }

narrative.overview:
A quiet reading room, lit warm. The left rail is the card catalogue — portrait, name, role, and a column of entries you scan with a finger. The content well is the open volume on the table. Nothing floats above the table, nothing glows, nothing asks for attention; the silence is the primary material and the light is warm rather than white.

The register is sober and precise. Authority here comes from rigour, not volume: every value is in its place, every number is tabular, every list is ordered by the key a reader would actually scan. The visitor is a peer who arrived knowing the name and wanting the artifact. The design's job is to hand it over without a detour and without a performance.

The warmth is deliberate and it is where the whole system departs from an institutional PDF. The ground is parchment (#f0eade), not white; the accent is a gold drawn out of that same paper rather than applied on top of it. Someone lives in this room. But the warmth never becomes decoration: it is the colour temperature of the paper, not an ornament laid over it.
keyCharacteristics: One typeface (Roboto) carrying display, body, data and label alike.
A seven-step type scale; no font-size outside it.
Parchment ground, three tonal surfaces, hairline rules — and no shadows anywhere.
A single radius: 2px on everything rectangular.
Gold reserved for structure: where you are, and by what key the list is ordered.
Justified prose with automatic hyphenation; metadata rows forced back to the left.
A rail that responds to viewport height as well as width.

rules.name: The Ramp Inversion Rule
rules.body: #decc96 is the site's tone but never its text colour on paper. On the light ground the accent ramp darkens away from it (Burnished → Olive → Deep Olive); in the dark theme the ramp inverts and lightens (accent-strong becomes #cbb87c, accent-ink becomes #e3d3a2, accent-deep becomes #f0e5c4). A new surface picks the sibling that meets contrast on its own ground — never accent itself for text.

rules.name: The Structural Accent Rule
rules.body: Gold marks two things and nothing else: where you are (the current nav bullet, the focus ring) and by what key this list is ordered (the year column, the semester heading, the bar under a section head). It never colours running prose, never fills a decorative area, never tints a whole section.

rules.name: The Two-Surface Rule
rules.body: There are exactly three tonal levels — Parchment behind, Paper for the shell, Warm Paper for the rail and framed figures. A fourth surface tone is not available; anything that needs to read as separate takes a hairline, not a new tint.

rules.name: The One Face Rule
rules.body: Roboto carries display, body, data and label alike. Role is signalled by size, weight, tracking and case, never by a second family. The --font-family-display and --font-family-data tokens exist as seams so a display face could be swapped in from one place — both currently resolve to Roboto, and a new surface does not get to fill them on its own initiative.

rules.name: The Seven Steps Rule
rules.body: Every font-size comes from the seven scale tokens (--text-xs 0.75rem through --text-2xl). Exactly two exceptions exist in the codebase and no third is authorized: the body anchor at 16px, and the labels inside the SVG diagram, which are measured in viewBox units rather than rem.

rules.name: The Justified Column Rule
rules.body: Prose is justified with hyphens: auto — the lede, card and award copy, timeline descriptions, abstracts. Metadata rows are then forced back to text-align: left with hyphens: manual: authors, venue, period, organisation, handle, figure captions, footer. Justification is for sentences; a data row that gets justified grows rivers and stops scanning. This preference is settled — do not revert it.

rules.name: The Height Tier Rule
rules.body: The rail responds to viewport height, not only width. At max-height: 760px the stack gap tightens and the portrait drops to 112px; at 690px the rail padding, sticky offset and nav rhythm all compress and the portrait drops to 84px; at 640px the portrait and the role detail disappear entirely. Nothing may be added to the rail without re-checking all three tiers — the failure mode is a scrollbar appearing inside the rail on a short laptop screen, and it has happened twice.

rules.name: The Ordering Key Column Rule
rules.body: Every accumulating list puts its ordering key in a fixed 62px left column — the year for publications, patents and awards; the semester for courses. The key is tabular (font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums) so the digits line up down the page. A list without a meaningful key uses .entry-list--plain and drops the column rather than filling it with something decorative.

rules.name: The 62ch Rule
rules.body: Running prose never exceeds 62 characters per line, on any viewport. Width is spent on lists, diagrams and metadata, never on longer measure.

rules.name: The 2px Rule
rules.body: Every rectangular thing takes 2px. It reads as cut paper rather than as a software control, and it is what keeps a chip, a card and a button feeling like the same material. A new component adopts 2px; it does not introduce a second step.

dos: Do take every font-size from the seven scale tokens, and every radius from 2px.
Do put the ordering key — year, semester — in the fixed 62px left column with tabular numerals, for any list that accumulates.
Do pick the accent sibling that meets contrast on its ground: Olive Gold (#7a5f13) for text on paper, Structural Gold (#a4822c) for a graphic element, Parchment Gold (#decc96) only as a fill.
Do keep running prose justified with hyphens: auto, and force metadata rows back to text-align: left with hyphens: manual.
Do separate things with a 1px hairline before reaching for a gap, a fill or a box.
Do verify a rail change at all three height tiers (760 / 690 / 640px) before calling it done.
Do write viewport-unit fallbacks as 100vh first and 100dvh/100svh inside an @supports block, so minification cannot drop the pair.
Do hold 4.5:1 for text and 3:1 for graphic elements in both themes — the dark palette is a full redefinition of the tokens, not an afterthought.
donts: Don't introduce a second typeface. Role is size, weight, tracking and case.
Don't colour running prose with gold, or tint a whole section with it. Gold marks position and ordering key only.
Don't use --accent (#decc96) as a text colour on a light ground — it cannot carry contrast there.
Don't add a fourth surface tone. Three tonal levels plus two rule weights is the whole depth vocabulary.
Don't let this read as a SaaS landing page: no gradients, no floating cards, no coloured icon in a circle, no testimonial section, no oversized CTA.
Don't let this read as a university institutional page: no carousel, no corporate blue, no stock banner of people pointing at a monitor, no breadcrumb on everything.
Don't let this read as a dev portfolio template: no neon-on-black, no monospace everywhere, no typing animation, no row of technology logos.

Don't let it collapse back into a raw Lattes dump either: a flat table at one weight with no hierarchy is the opposite failure, and the ordering-key column, the bolded author name and the section rules exist precisely to prevent it.
Don't animate position or size. Colour only, 0.15s ease.
Don't add a third exception to the type scale, or a spacing value that no other component uses.
